overview: Saratoga Springs is a large Disney Vacation Club resort inspired by the spa and horse-racing towns of upstate New York. It sits across the lake from Disney Springs.
suits: Families and groups who want villa space and easy evenings at Disney Springs.
rooms:
As a Disney Vacation Club resort, rooms range from studios with a kitchenette to multi-bedroom villas with a full kitchen and washer and dryer. You don't need to be a member to stay; you can book with cash like a regular hotel.

The Treehouse Villas are raised standalone homes that sleep up to nine.
pools: The main High Rock Spring Pool has rock formations, waterslides and a hot tub.
dining: Turf Club Bar & Grill is the table-service restaurant and The Artist's Palette is the quick-service spot. The resort also has a full-service spa.
pros: Walk or take a boat to Disney Springs
cons: Very large, with several bus stops
tips: Walk over to Disney Springs for dinner.
Choose a section near the main building if you don't want internal buses.
bestFor: Families and groups who want space near Disney Springs.
